== Overview ==
It is enshrined at the foot of the mountains in the Ōgamo area, to the north and upstream of the Ōgamo River, which flows through the Kisami district west of Shimoda City.

Although the date of establishment is unknown, the shrine is identified with '''Izunahime-no-Mikoto Shrine''' (いつなひめのみことじんじゃ), a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}, and is an ancient shrine recorded in the '{{ill|Izu Province Shrine Rank Register|ja|伊豆国神階帳|qid=Q17193087}}' as “Junior Fourth Rank, Upper: Itsunahime no Myōjin.”<ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/sutou_title.htm Sutō Shrine] - Genmatsuko</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140112-01.html Sutō Shrine] - Research on Engishiki Shrines</ref>
